images.filename: Serbian Orthodox Church in Coober Pedy.jpg
images.caption: Interior of the Serbian Orthodox Church in Coober Pedy, South Australia.  Like many of the dwellings in Coober Pedy, the church is a dugout, which is essentially a chamber drilled into the side of a hill.  After the drilling is complete, the rock is sealed with polyurethane or similar sealant, and that forms the walls that you see.
